episodes.title: Dog & Chainsaw
episodes.synopsis: Denji is a teenager who lives his life as a Devil Hunter. Aiming to pay off the debt he inherited from his father, he starts hunting devils for the yakuza with his buddy Pochita, a "Chainsaw Devil", while living a tragically poor life. Just when things seem like they couldn't get any worse, Denji gets betrayed and killed by the yakuza. As Denji starts passing out, he hears someone calling from inside his head...

episodes.title: Arrival in Tokyo
episodes.synopsis: After being taken into custody by Makima, one of the Public Safety Devil Hunters, Denji finds himself head over heels in love with her thanks to her suggestive insinuations. Wishing to team up with Makima, Denji arrives at the Devil Hunters Headquarters in Tokyo, and gets introduced to Aki Hayakawa, a senior hunter that he was supposed to partner with. But then Hayakawa beats Denji up, and demands that he “quit this job”...

info.title: Harmony of Mille-Feuille
info.synopsis: Uta Komaki è una ragazza del primo anno delle superiori con una grande passione per il canto, ma è estremamente timida e insicura. Desidera unirsi al club di musica leggera della scuola, ma si sente sopraffatta dalla presenza dei membri più esperti e carismatici. In un momento di sconforto, riceve un invito a unirsi al club di canto a cappella, guidato dalla presidente Airi Kojo. Questo gruppo è composto da individui unici, alcuni dei quali potrebbero sembrare eccentrici. Anche se non sono popolari o appariscenti, condividono una passione profonda per la musica e una connessione speciale che li unisce attraverso le loro voci.

episodes.title: Pop Music Debut?!
episodes.synopsis: April. Uta, a freshman, is starting high school and aims to join the light music club. However, when she sees the glamorous boys and girls of the light music club chatting away, her extremely negative personality makes her hesitant to take the first step.

episodes.title: Ururun TV
episodes.synopsis: Uta struggles with her first a cappella practice. Meanwhile, a new member candidate found by club president Airi becomes a hot topic. All the club members go out to recruit her to take on the role of "voice percussion," a unique part of a cappella.

episodes.title: A Rational Man

episodes.title: A Sky with No Rain Left

episodes.title: Farewell Party!

episodes.title: Zero Hour
episodes.synopsis: Captain Celebrity's farewell party begins, but the Scarred Man has some unpleasant surprises in store...

episodes.title: Balloon Soul
episodes.synopsis: Captain Celebrity tries to save the Sky Egg with Koichi's help, while reminiscing on what brought him here.

episodes.title: This Is a Hero!!
episodes.synopsis: The Sky Egg falls as Captain Celebrity hits his limit, with only one person capable of saving the day...

episodes.title: Graduation and Career Path
episodes.synopsis: Captain Celebrity returns to the United States, and Koichi must decide what to do with his future.

info.title: Waccha PriMagi!
info.synopsis: Matsuri Hibino, studentessa del primo anno delle scuole medie, adora i festival e sogna di poter un giorno recitare in "PriMagi", una forma magica di intrattenimento teatrale nata dal canto, dalla danza e dalla moda. Quel giorno arriva quando l'inquietante ma divertente maga Myamu arriva dal regno magico e cerca proprio Matsuri per PriMagi. Insieme, le due competono con le altre rivali per scalare la vetta del successo.

episodes.title: Let`s Compete in the PriMagi!
episodes.synopsis: Myamu wants to win the PriMagi, but first she’ll need a lookbook. And before she can get a lookbook, she’ll need a partner! Wow, becoming a PriMagi star sure is a lot of work…

episodes.title: Here We Go! The Festival Stage
episodes.synopsis: Recon is an important part of honing one’s craft, so Myamu and Matsuri check out Miruki, another PriMagi star performing at a local festival. But there’s just one problem…

episodes.title: A Visit from Hina, the Queen of Style!
episodes.synopsis: So many new faces, but are Matsuri’s fellow PriMagi hopefuls new friends or budding rivals? Or maybe they’re both…

episodes.title: The Duo Disbands?! It`s Way Too Soon for That!
episodes.synopsis: Wait, Myamu wants to disband!? She claims she needs a better partner, but is that the real reason she’s run away from Matsuri?

episodes.title: Hey, Look! It`s the Super-Duper Cute Miruki! (Heart)
episodes.synopsis: All’s fair in love and war… and fashion photography! Miruki won’t pull any punches to sabotage Matsuri’s big break, but Matsuri has luck on her side.

episodes.title: The Dark PriMagi Superstar?! Lemon Takes the Stage!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon Kokoa might be shy, but she has big PriMagi dreams! She’ll have to find the courage to perform somehow. Maybe Hina and Matsuri can offer some inspiration.

episodes.title: The Downright Merry Meowgnificent Magical Realm!
episodes.synopsis: An unexpected trip to the magical realm makes Myamu and Gramps butt heads, but Lemon’s ability to sniff out “key items” may just bring them together again…

episodes.title: A Crash Course with Hina-senpai! OMG, OMG, I`m Doomed!
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri joins Hina for a training session to improve her PriMagi skills, but Hina’s intense routine and unmatched passion leaves her feeling the burn!

episodes.title: A Heart Awakens! `Tis the Advent of Lemon!!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon knows just what to do to cheer up Matsuri, but when Lemon finally gets her turn on the PriMagi stage, Matsuri will need to do the cheering instead!

episodes.title: Nothing Beats the PriMagi! A Mega-Enthusiastic Meet-up!
episodes.synopsis: While out celebrating Lemon’s debut, Matsuri and her friends take a look through their lookbooks to see how far they’ve come — all in preparation for the challenges ahead!

episodes.title: Fly, Hina! Conquer Your Loneliness!
episodes.synopsis: PriMagi superstar Jennifer makes a shocking announcement that leaves Hina feeling rattled before a huge performance. The show must go on, but can Hina shine in her condition?

episodes.title: Matsuri vs Hina: Upon Whom Will the Phoenix Smile?
episodes.synopsis: Hina and Matsuri might be friends, but there can only be one PriMagi superstar! Which of their stars is about to rise, and whose will come falling back to earth?

episodes.title: The Magic Word Is Waccha
episodes.synopsis: Something is wrong with Myamu. Between her troubles and Matsuri’s doubts, the pair will have to pull off a miracle to get Matsuri to the top — but they’re up to the challenge!

episodes.title: Passionate, Mysterious, Elegant: Amane`s PriMagi
episodes.synopsis: Prince Amane is in trouble, or at least that’s what her PriMagi partner claims. Amane says everything is fine, but Hina suspects Amane’s acting skills are working overtime.

episodes.title: So Much for That! I`m Sick of This Stupid Training Camp!
episodes.synopsis: At a special training camp for top stars, the team of hopefuls must work together to survive the week, but some students don’t want to shoulder their fair share of chores…

episodes.title: Touma`s "Magi," Hughie`s "Magi"
episodes.synopsis: An impromptu trip to the magical world with the mysterious Hughie puts Touma in grave danger, but Matsuri and her friends are on their way to help!

episodes.title: Chimumu Says Thanks for Everything, Chimu...
episodes.synopsis: The stars of the training camp aren’t the only ones who need to get serious about their craft. Their magical partners have work to do, too!

episodes.title: Amane`s Heart, a Secret Garden
episodes.synopsis: When a magical rose reveals Amane’s hidden feelings, animosity flowers amid the stars at the special training camp.

episodes.title: Together! On Another Journey to the Magical Realm!
episodes.synopsis: During a surprise day off, the stars take a break from the cameras and visit the Magical Realm… but the magical paparazzi wants to put them right back in the spotlight!

episodes.title: The Trial of a Lifetime! Miruki`s Cute Court Case!
episodes.synopsis: The results of the audience poll leave the stars in turmoil — and with an unprecedented decision to make. But Miruki has a (slightly suspicious) plan to get the votes.

episodes.title: I Am Jennifer!
episodes.synopsis: It’s Jennifer-mania when the legendary star returns for an unexpected performance! But something about her energy feels off. Looks like even champions struggle sometimes…

episodes.title: Tune In for a Special Broadcast! Ole!
episodes.synopsis: In a pre-exhibition special, the Superstars showcase their past performances to pick the most impressive among them — but not all feel ready to shine their brightest.

episodes.title: The Final Test: A Five-Man Center!
episodes.synopsis: It's time to face the music. The top stars must band together to put on a performance of a lifetime!

episodes.title: Exhibition, Here We Come! Five Times the Magi!
episodes.synopsis: The girls celebrate the success of their five-man center, but the reality of the PriMagi is waiting in the wings. What comes after this feeling of happiness…?

episodes.title: Identity Data File: In the Case of Auru Omega
episodes.synopsis: A new challenger has emerged, but Auru Omega has an unorthodox view of the PriMagi. She intends to win not with magic, but with science! Can her clinical approach get results?

episodes.title: Auru`s Eikichi Research Guide!
episodes.synopsis: Auru’s newest research mission: understanding Matsuri and her PriMagi skills! Will spending time with Matsuri and her family unlock the next step in Auru’s PriMagi evolution?

episodes.title: The Fate That Binds Us
episodes.synopsis: Behind the glittering face of the PriMagi stage, ominous forces move in the shadows. A new future for the PriMagi approaches, but what does this mean for Matsuri and Myamu?

episodes.title: You`re My Precious One! Our Magi!
episodes.synopsis: The Earthly and the Treasured have worked together for centuries, but if Omega has their way, things for the PriMagi are about to change — permanently.

episodes.title: Who`s Gonna Team Up? It`s a Matchmaking Competition
episodes.synopsis: After witnessing a surprise performance from an unlikely pair, the rest of the superstars want to try a duo PriMagi, too! But Miruki has some reservations about teaming up…

episodes.title: Glasses and Contacts
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri wants to perform a duo PriMagi with Auru, but Auru has always done things better alone. In fact, she’s ALWAYS been alone… hasn’t she?

episodes.title: Magi? Technology? It`s Time for a Duo PriMagi!
episodes.synopsis: Auru and Matsuri are performing together? Talk about an odd couple! Can magic and technology learn to work in harmony, or will this team-up end in discord?

episodes.title: A Lonesome Flower: Amane`s Magi
episodes.synopsis: Amane and Hina have a duo to perform, but how can you pour your heart into something when you don’t know what your heart holds? Amane must look inward to discover the truth.

episodes.title: Those Who Shoot For the Stars
episodes.synopsis: Hina is this year’s Samba Sun Goddess, but the arrival of another PriMagi Superstar has cast a shadow over her shining moment...

episodes.title: My Very Own Vivid Star
episodes.synopsis: PriMagi Superstars may be rivals, but they’re also friends. No matter what, they’ll be there for Hina while she finds her footing after her confrontation with Jennifer.

episodes.title: Fly High! Hina and Amane`s Duo!
episodes.synopsis: Hina fans vs. Amane fans — two households, both alike in dignity, in fair PriMagi, where we lay our scene. Can a duo between Amane and Hina strive to mend this ancient grudge?

episodes.title: Farewell, Lemon! Carron Bows Out
episodes.synopsis: When Lemon’s nerves get the best of her, Miruki sees an opportunity to shine solo — and Carron runs out of patience with her PriMagi partner.

episodes.title: Are You Sure About This?! MiruLemo Date!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon and Miruki go on a date, but things don't go according to plan.

episodes.title: `Tis the Moment of Truth! This Here Is Our Duo!
episodes.synopsis: Lemon learns something surprising about Miruki.

episodes.title: A Red-Hot Dreamer: Achihiko Omega
episodes.synopsis: The CEO of the mysterious Omega Corporation reveals the philosophy driving his ambitions during a special look back at the meteoric rise of the latest PriMagi superstars.

episodes.title: You Are My Sunshine
episodes.synopsis: As various players' motivations come to light, PriMagi as an institution faces a reckoning that could change the landscape of that magical stage forevermore.

episodes.title: Is the PriMagi Gone for Good?!
episodes.synopsis: The deed is done and there is no going back. Now, the Elemental Spirits and the mysterious Euphoria Revue holds the key to what happens next.

episodes.title: The Distance Between Me and My Magi
episodes.synopsis: Problems that can't be solved by the Earthly must be solved by the Treasured, and the Treasured intend to use force. But Lemon wants to take a different approach.

episodes.title: I Want to Win! Hear My Magi Roar!
episodes.synopsis: The stars must succeed at the Euphoria Revue, but who will be the next to unlock her Heavens Form? The upcoming PriMagj will be crucial for whoever takes to the stage!

episodes.title: Have a Taste of Miruki`s Milky Dream (Wink)
episodes.synopsis: Miruki wants to unlock her Heavens Form right NOW! But the Element who just came calling has a rather odd request. Is changing who she is really worth all this!?

info.title: Ghost Cat Anzu
info.synopsis: Karin è una ragazza di undici anni che viene abbandonata dal padre a case del nonno, un monaco di una piccola cittadina della campagna giapponese. Il nonno chiede ad Anzu, un gatto fantasma tanto gioviale quanto capriccioso, di prendersi cura della nipote. All'inizio fra i due nascono scintille a causa dei loro forti caratteri, ma poi...

episodes.title: Sigh and Girlfriend

episodes.title: Promised Time and Girlfriend

episodes.title: Family Trip and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: It's time for the Kinoshita tradition—a two-night, three-day trip to Spa Resort Hawaiians!

episodes.title: Hawaiians and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: The Hawaiians stay begins in absolute chaos as Mami has joined the fray!

episodes.title: Strings and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Chizuru and Kazuya deal with a little incident, blissfully unaware of the moves Mami is making.

episodes.title: For My First Time and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Ruka has her doubts about this trip, and her doubts are amplified by the conversations she has!

episodes.title: Ring Finger and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Chizuru and Ruka have run-ins with the Kinoshita family women.

episodes.title: Guilt and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Mami confronts Chizuru and urges her to make a decision.

episodes.title: Paradise and Girlfriend
episodes.synopsis: Kazuya's filled with guilt after Nagomi's display of gratitude, and Chizuru has a decision to make with Mami.

info.title: Dragon Ball Z Movie 02: Il Più Forte Del Mondo
info.synopsis: Gohan e Oolong, cercando le Sfere del Drago, scoprono che uno scienziato malvagio le sta raccogliendo per liberare dai ghiacci un potentissimo collega. Riuscendoci, questi va in cerca dell'uomo più forte del mondo, ed essendo stato tanto tempo congelato, è convinto che sia il Maestro Muten. Non ha, però, fatto i conti con Goku, che si lancerà contro di lui per fermarlo.

episodes.title: Complete Movie
episodes.synopsis: The evil Dr. Kochin uses the dragon balls to resurrect his mentor, Dr. Wheelo, in an effort to take over the world. Dr. Wheelo, his body having been destroyed by the avalanche that killed him fifty years before, desires the body of the strongest fighter in the world as his new vessel. Believing Roshi to be the world's strongest warrior, Dr. Kochin abducts Bulma and forces Roshi to surrender himself to save her. When Goku hears of their abduction, he goes to their rescue.
